_about: LLP 1166.000 D2. Each tree node has a unique id, an optional HTML tag (div by default), role, literal DOM attrs, direction and visibility (CSS), and children; contract, where set, names the Contract element the node lowers from, which the kernel test builds as contract/lower does, while tag is the element the web makes of it. focus names the active member or is null. A key case expects the kernel destination (null means unhandled) and whether to press it; a stop case expects the sole Tab stop or null. axis is the host sidebar override; the web fixture represents it with data-exact-sidebar on the group parent. Expected answers follow host/web/input-glue.js. hidden means display:none. Boolean ARIA attrs are written as true/false strings in a DOM.
